_note: Fictional household used by the public demo. All people, places and numbers are invented.

recipient.name: Mireille
recipient.role: mum, 81, lives alone in Leuven, uses a walker

members.name: Anouk
members.role: daughter, lives nearby, visits most weekdays

members.name: Bram
members.role: son, lives in Ghent, visits at weekends

members.name: Sofie
members.role: home nurse, morning and evening rounds

notes.text: Mum had a good morning. She walked to the bakery with her walker and back, about 15 minutes. Ate all her soup at lunch. She likes her coffee with warm milk, never cold.
Evening round. New eye drops for the left eye every evening at 21:00 for the next month, prescribed by Dr. Claes. Blood pressure 162/94, higher than usual.
Phoned Mum. She sounded cheerful and told me about the neighbour's new dog. She forgot she had already told me the same story on Sunday.
Dr. Claes started amlodipine 5 mg once a day in the morning for her blood pressure. First dose today with breakfast. I need to pick up the second box from the pharmacy on Friday.
Morning round. Took amlodipine with breakfast. Showered with help, skin fine. She mentioned her ankles feel a bit puffy.
She felt dizzy getting up from the armchair after lunch. Sat down again and it passed after a minute. Did not want to walk to the bakery today.
Weekend visit. Fixed the loose rug in the hallway. Mum was a bit unsteady on the stairs and held the rail with both hands. Slept badly, up twice in the night.
Ankles swollen yesterday evening, better this morning. Dizzy again when standing up quickly, so I told her to stand up slowly. Physio exercises every Monday and Thursday at 10:00, Anouk helps.
Lovely afternoon, we sorted old photos and she laughed a lot. Ate well. Still says the room spins a little when she gets up. Remember to ask the GP about the dizziness.
Blood pressure 138/84. Eye drops done. She is allergic to penicillin - make sure that is on her file at the new pharmacy.
Called the practice: GP appointment with Dr. Claes next Tuesday at 10:30. Anouk will take her. Taxi picks her up at Vaartstraat 12 at 10:00. Practice number is 016 23 45 67.
Short visit before work. She slept better. Ankles a bit puffy again. Took her amlodipine. She wants to go to the market on Saturday with Bram.
